description:
BYTE FORCE is a team of passionate innovators interested in artificial intelligence, technology, coding, data science, and space exploration. We aim to solve real-world challenges through creativity, teamwork, and innovation. We welcome enthusiastic members skilled or interested in Python, AI/ML, web development, data analysis, UI/UX design, scientific research, and communication. We believe in learning together and turning bold ideas into impactful solutions.

Code. Innovate. Conquer.
